newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Global 3Q NAV $92.3 mln vs $86.5mln.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Global 3Q NAV $92.3 mln vs $86.5mln.

text.p: Alliance Global Environment Fund Inc said on Friday its net asset value rose to $92.3 million in the third quarter from $86.5 million in the same period a year ago.
It also said in a statement it had repurchased 9.5 percent, or 658,200, of its outstanding common stock, as part of a previously announced 20 percent share buyback program.

"The program has added more than two percent to shareholders' net asset value since it beganin March," Alliance Global Environment's Board Chairman John Carifa said in a statement. "The funds recent performance continues to be exceptional and we expect to continue the share repurchase program on the terms previously announced."
Alliance said it paid a total of $8.23 million to repurchase the shares at a cost of about $12.51 per share.
The fund said as of July 31, its NAV per share was $14.56 based on 6,339,069 shares outstanding, versus $12.52 on 6,907,169 shares outstanding in the third quarter last year.
